name: Acorn
source:
The world is ending before your life even started. A fresh graduate, you never thought of what your future held, but you were sure you wanted to spend it with your closest loved ones: Your sister, best friend, and boyfriend.  The issue lies in the impossible choice you have to make-- Who will you spend your last day alive with?

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/acorn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在你的生命开始之前，世界就已经结束了。作为一名应届毕业生，你从未想过自己的未来会怎样，但你确信自己想与最亲近的人一起度过：你的妹妹、最好的朋友和男朋友。问题在于你必须做出一个不可能的选择——你将与谁度过生命的最后一天？

[来自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/acorn]itch.io[/url]]
